source_commit_note: This is the tested and packaged source SHA; any later docs-only delivery commit is distinct.
scope: focused affected and dependent unit, HTTP, ownership, and package version checks for Wall native-material ownership across alternate parent view wrappers

environment.http_loopback: network permission enabled for focused HTTP checks

counting_method: Union of unittest test IDs across the affected/dependent module command and package version test. The 25-test Wall material + HTTP rerun after fake cleanup overlaps the broad command and is not counted again.

groups.name: affected material, HTTP, edit, native setter, and ownership modules
groups.command: UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache uv run --frozen env PYTHONPATH=tests python -m unittest test_wall_material_edit test_wall_material_http test_model_edit test_native_model_edit test_edit_ownership -v

groups.name: Wall material and HTTP rerun after fixture cleanup
groups.command: UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache uv run --frozen env PYTHONPATH=tests python -m unittest test_wall_material_edit test_wall_material_http -v

groups.name: package version and lock agreement
groups.command: UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache uv run --frozen env PYTHONPATH=tests python -m unittest test_package.PackageTests.test_version_and_lock_agree -v

coverage_note: Fake SDK tests require a same-model alternate parent view to be accepted with the observed view bound and fresh material readback; wrapper-view drift conflicts before ModifyElements; different model, type, or drawing parent identity remains blocked. Fake results are automated evidence only and are not Allplan acceptance.
